maya: Quick report 10: ran into confusing behavior in the Python SDK async batching helper used by the embeddings + rerank sample app during onboarding. Single-input async responses sometimes get unwrapped and the rerank helper treats a float vector as an iterable of docs.

oliver: Not great. Can you paste a short repro and what you expected?

maya: Repro (async path, trimmed):

maya: ```py
resp = await client.embeddings.create(model='embed-text-1', input='a single sentence')
print(type(resp.data), len(resp.data))
print(repr(resp.data[0]))
```

maya: Expectation: resp.data -> list containing one list[float]. Actual: intermittently resp.data becomes a flat list-of-floats (i.e., resp.data == [0.1, 0.2, ...]) so rerank._prepare_docs iterates the floats and crashes with `TypeError: cannot iterate float`. Local repro maybe 2-4/10 runs.

ben: That matches a bug I saw in the async normalizer. There's a helper _maybe_unwrap_singletons that returns out[0] when len(out) == 1. Sync client has a normalization layer that always yields list-of-items; async path mistakenly unwraps. Race with batching timing explains nondeterminism.

oliver: Do we have a stack?

maya: Short stack: `TypeError: cannot iterate float` inside rerank._prepare_docs -> `for doc in docs:` where docs is a float vector.

ben: I'm pretty sure the unwrap helper is wired into the async response pipeline. Quick search shows: client/_normalize.py -> _maybe_unwrap_singletons used in async response handler.

docs-bot: Created issue: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/487 10 "async embeddings: singleton unwrapping causes rerank shape mismatch". Added labels: dx, api-parity.

maya: Suggested fix: enforce contract where embeddings.create always returns List[List[float]] and rerank helpers always accept List[str] docs and List[List[float]] embeddings. Normalization should occur at call entry (wrap single input -> list) and never unwrap on the way out. Update types & sample apps.

oliver: Agreed. Less breaking rollout plan: 1) patch SDK to normalize inputs (wrap singletons) and ensure outputs are always lists (nonbreaking). 2) update typing stubs and sampleapp to show the list shape. 3) add deprecation note if we previously documented unwrapped responses.

ben: Draft patch idea:

ben: ```py
# embeddings.py
async def create(self, *, input):
    inputs = input if isinstance(input, (list, tuple)) else [input]
    resp = await self._call_api(inputs=inputs)
    embeddings = [it['embedding'] for it in resp['data']]
    return SimpleNamespace(data=embeddings)
```

maya: Also need to adjust rerank helper so it doesn't accept nested union shapes in type hints. Make it explicit: def rerank(query: str, docs: List[str], doc_embeddings: List[List[float]]). Add runtime asserts in debug builds.

oliver: I'll open a PR that: removes async singleton unwrapping, normalizes inputs at entry, updates typing stubs, fixes sampleapp snippets, and adds unit+integration tests covering single vs multi inputs on both sync and async paths. We'll also add a tiny upgrade note in the SDK CHANGELOG.

ci-bot: PR #912 opened 10 tests failing on windows-3.8 matrix due to unrelated path separator flake.

ben: I'll patch the flake and add an integration test that runs the sampleapp flow (embeddings -> rerank) end-to-end to catch future regressions. I'll also add a deterministic unit test that simulates interleaved batches to catch unwrap races.

maya: Thanks. Docs update: add the one-line pattern for onboarding pages: `inputs = [inputs] if isinstance(inputs, str) else inputs` and show the stable response shape. Saves new users confusion.

oliver: Sounds good. We'll include a migration snippet in the changelog and mark behavior as "stabilized shape" rather than a breaking API change since we're only removing a surprising unwrap. ETA for PR with tests & docs: EOD tomorrow.

maya: Great 10 I'll attach logs and a flaky repro test in the issue. Leaving this thread here.

ben: Labels on issue/PR: dx-bug, api-parity, priority-medium.

oliver: :thumbsup:
